title: Diegetic turn-order age pips (`1`, `2`, `3`) subtly etched into the corner of each occupied sector so both contenders can read the decay queue at a glance.
summary: Render diegetic chronometric age pips etched into sector inner corners reflecting queue positions 1, 2, and 3.
technical_specification: In sector render pass, if `state.stats.ephemeralProtocol` is true and sector is occupied, determine age `pipCount`: `queue.indexOf(sectorIdx) + 1` (1 = oldest/expiring, 3 = newest). Render `pipCount` geometric micro-diamonds (radius `2.5px`, spaced `6px` along sector top-right inset `x: sector.x + 104, y: sector.y + 14`). Pip styling: oldest pip (`age = 1`) flickers with erratic phase `Math.sin(state.world.time * 12) > 0 ? 0.3 : 0.9` in faction warning tint; pips 2 and 3 render solid luminous obsidian-gold. Prohibit rectangular HUD overlays or text numerals.
acceptance_criteria: Each occupied cell displays 1, 2, or 3 distinct diegetic corner diamond pips reflecting queue maturity.
Pip with age index 1 (next eviction) visibly flickers at high frequency.
Zero textual numerals or rectangular HUD boxes appear within the lattice.
